notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 1657 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Dy; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.995$ kcal/mol. 
1682 K, melting point of Dy; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.643$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 8.875 + 0.036 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.608 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=8.875\times10^{-3}T+0.018\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.608\times10^{2}T^{-1}-2.852$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-1657 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = 22.837 + 1.214 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 2.367 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 195.850 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = 22.837 - 1.214 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 2.367 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 97.925 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 10.549 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1657-1682 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 21.154 - 1.996 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.142 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 26.650 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 21.154 + 1.996 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.142 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 13.325 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 29.611 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1682-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 27.308 - 7.226 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.142 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 26.650 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 27.308 + 7.226 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.142 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 13.325 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 72.117 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Source: Data from Mills (80) who estimated all except enthalpy of formation at 298 K.
